ui.situacijaNote: Billing by degree of completion from the daily reports, month by month.

day.photosShown: Photos: {shown} of {total}. All are stored in Belin.

po.regieClause: Day-work hours. The contractor records day-work on hour sheets in Belin. The client approves or rejects a submitted sheet within six days of submission, counting Monday to Saturday excluding public holidays; the day of submission does not count. If the client does not respond within that period, the sheet is deemed approved. Approved hours are charged at the hourly rate in this order.

basis.si: Matters not covered by this order are governed by the Slovenian Obligations Code (Obligacijski zakonik) and the Special Construction Usages 2020 (Posebne gradbene uzance 2020).
basis.de: Matters not covered by this order are governed by the VOB/B in the version in force when the contract is concluded.
basis.at: Matters not covered by this order are governed by ÖNORM B 2110 in the version in force when the contract is concluded.

po.acceptedBody: The contractor accepted this purchase order in Belin. The fingerprint refers to the version of the order that was sent, which the contractor reviewed and accepted; this copy only adds the acceptance certificate.

regie.rateValue: {rate} per hour, under purchase order no. {number}
regie.noRate: The purchase order sets no hourly rate.
regie.rule: Client response period: six days after submission, counting Monday to Saturday excluding public holidays. Deadline for this sheet: {deadline}.
regie.rulePo: This term is agreed in purchase order no. {number}.
regie.deemedAt: Deemed approved when the period ended
regie.pending: Waiting for a decision by the client.

abnahme.reservation: The contractor remedies the agreed defects at own cost within the stated deadlines. No agreement was reached on defects marked {disputed}.
abnahme.basisSi: Basis: usages 112 and 114 of the Slovenian Special Construction Usages 2020.

co.title: Change order
co.noAmount: No amount set. Without an amount the work is not invoiced.
co.basisSi: Under usage 34 of the Slovenian Special Construction Usages 2020 the contract price does not include additional work; its price is agreed separately.
co.approvedNote: The client approved this claim in Belin.
co.rejectedNote: The client rejected this claim in Belin.
co.pendingNote: This claim is waiting for a decision by the client.

poster.title: Join the site
poster.scan: Scan the code with your phone camera
poster.step1: Open the phone camera and point it at the code.
poster.step2: Enter your name and email, then open the link you receive.
poster.step3: Send a short report with photos every day.
poster.noApp: No app to install. The phone remembers you.

situacija.title: Interim statement
situacija.method: The degree of completion is the weighted average completion of the items in the crew daily reports.
situacija.methodSi: Billing by degree of completion is permitted by usage 60 of the Slovenian Special Construction Usages 2020.
situacija.paymentSi: Payment within eight days of receipt (usage 62 of the Slovenian Special Construction Usages 2020), unless the purchase order states otherwise.
situacija.disputeSi: The client may dispute the statement within 15 days of receipt; otherwise it counts as confirmed (usage 63 of the Slovenian Special Construction Usages 2020).
situacija.extrasExcluded: Change orders and day-work hours are not included; they are billed separately.
situacija.notInvoice: This statement is a record of work done for confirmation and is not an invoice.

ovira.title: Notice of obstruction
ovira.intro: The contractor gives notice that an obstruction has arisen on site that prevents the work from being carried out as agreed:
ovira.request: The contractor requests an extension of the completion deadline for the duration of the obstruction and the time needed to restart the work. We ask the client to remove the obstruction or to give instructions for continuing.

basis.si: Notice is given in writing under usage 8, and the extension is requested under usages 41 and 43 of the Slovenian Special Construction Usages 2020.
basis.at: Notice of obstruction under ÖNORM B 2110.

ovira.noNote: No description of the obstruction was recorded.
